name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle and two or three wheels on the ground; a motor-driven cycle or motorized bicycle operated past 30 mph is one.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and two or three wheels on the ground; a three-wheeled vehicle with a cab and windshield isn't one (D.C. Code §31-2402(16); 18 DCMR 9901.1)
A motor-driven cycle or motorized bicycle becomes one when operated past 30 mph (D.C. Code §31-2402(16); 18 DCMR 9901.1)
Rider and passenger must wear a protective helmet (D.C. Law 19-290)
Carries a passenger only on a seat designed for one, or a sidecar (D.C. Law 19-290)
A motor vehicle under DC's compulsory insurance law (D.C. Code §31-2402(16))
